schema_note: kgco2e_per_wan is the legacy input column name; source contains CO2 only (GWP=1), not a full GHG inventory
price_basis: 2017 producer-price domestic MRIO aggregation; no purchaser-price, import or inter-year deflator adjustment
excluded_scope: Urban and rural household emissions excluded from production sector intensities
crosswalk_note: Broad CEADs transport/telecommunications, trade/catering and other-service sectors are allocated to 42-sector targets in proportion to gross output. This is a documented research assumption, NOT an observed official 42-sector emissions inventory. Logging included in agriculture. Repair included in other-services allocation.
